name: Intelligence Class Ladder — Temporal‑Ignition Apex Geometry
summary: Defines the apex-level ignition geometry of the Intelligence Class Ladder, including apex ignition-wave formation, ignition-corridor apex binding, resonance-ignition coupling, and apex corrected-time ignition stability.
purpose: Provide the apex ignition geometry for the Ladder, describing how apex ignition waves form, stabilize, bind, and integrate with resonance, corridor, and corrected-time surfaces to maintain high-load ignition behavior across AAI, AGI, and SI.
